IDENTITY LOCK: the attached reference image is the single source of truth for this character's FACE, HAIR, BODY and PROPORTIONS. Reproduce that exact individual — same facial structure, same hairline and hair shape, same stubble, same eye colour, same head-to-body ratio, same shoulder width, same limb length. Do NOT redesign, restyle, age, slim, lengthen or beautify the character. Change ONLY the pose and the facing direction. Do not copy the reference's pose or facing. CLOTHING RESET — this overrides the reference: strip the character down to his plain tight undergarment layer, a collarless undershirt and close-fitting trousers, with bare forearms, bare shins and bare feet. Remove every belt, shoulder strap, outer tunic, robe, skirt, sash, cloak, armour piece, helmet, boot, shoe, gauntlet, bracer, wrap, pouch and accessory the reference shows. Remove any weapon or shield the reference may show. The result must be the same man, unarmed and stripped to his underlayer, standing in a neutral stance with nothing for gear to rest on.
ROLE/PURPOSE: production base sprite for the player-controlled protagonist of a 2D side-scrolling roguelite.
SUBJECT: the character from the reference image, in a calm neutral ready stance, standing upright, arms slightly away from the body.
VIEW: strict orthographic SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, no perspective.
ART DIRECTION: Dark-fantasy woodcut / late-medieval engraving. Every form is built as carved layered facets with hard chiselled edges and dense fine hatching strokes for shading. Absolutely NO soft gradients, NO smooth airbrushing, NO glossy anime rendering. Muted desaturated earth palette ONLY: ink outline #1a1611, shadow #251f18, body #393126, lit plane #655a49, top highlight #8a7d68. Skin #6b5a48. The single warm accent permitted in the whole image is a faint ember-orange #ff7a3c glint in the eyes. Light source is fixed at upper-left on every asset. Four-layer shading convention throughout: dark outline, body mass, lit face, small highlight.
GAME-SCALE READ: at 96x144 px the head, the shoulder line and the empty hands must be instantly readable as a silhouette; the figure must read as a carved wooden effigy, never as a cartoon or a smooth 3D render.
TECHNICAL OUTPUT: single isolated character or item, native size 96x144 px, fully transparent background (real alpha channel, no checkerboard, no white or coloured matte), character standing on the bottom edge with feet at the very bottom, centred horizontally, no perspective distortion.
LOCKS: preserve the character's identity, stocky proportions, head shape, palette, and line weight exactly across every asset; preserve the upper-left light direction; keep the same carved-woodcut rendering language.
EXCLUDE: text, labels, watermarks, mockup frames, borders, background scenery, ground, floor shadow, duplicate characters, cropped edges, signature, UI chrome, colour swatches. ALSO EXCLUDE, and this is absolute: no weapon of any kind, no sword, no blade, no axe, no spear, no staff, no bow, no shield, no buckler, no armour piece, no helmet, no cape on the body layer. The body layer is a bare unarmed base figure in plain cloth: hands are empty and clearly visible. Equipment is composited on top of this layer later as separate images, so anything held or worn here would double up and collide.
